features.name: One-Time Pokemon Nickname
features.description: Allow users to set a nickname for their Pokemon, but only once per Pokemon

tasks.title: Add nicknameSetAt field to UserPokemon model
tasks.description: Add a nullable DateTime field 'nicknameSetAt' to track when nickname was first set. This enforces the one-time rule. Run migration after.

tasks.title: Update PATCH endpoint to enforce one-time nickname
tasks.description: Modify the Pokemon PATCH handler in api/pokemon/[...path].js to: 1) Check if nicknameSetAt is already set, 2) If set, reject nickname changes with error, 3) If not set and nickname provided, set both nickname and nicknameSetAt

tasks.title: Add setNickname API method
tasks.description: Add a setNickname(pokemonId, nickname) method to the API service that calls PATCH /api/pokemon/:id with the nickname

tasks.title: Add useSetNickname mutation hook
tasks.description: Create a React Query mutation hook for setting nicknames, invalidating pokemon queries on success

tasks.title: Add nickname input to Pokemon detail modal in Collection
tasks.description: In the Collection page's Pokemon detail modal, add: 1) Show current nickname or 'No nickname' if null, 2) If nicknameSetAt is null, show an input field and 'Set Nickname' button, 3) If nicknameSetAt is set, show nickname as read-only with '(permanent)' indicator, 4) Validation: 1-20 characters

tasks.title: Include nicknameSetAt in Pokemon API response
tasks.description: Update the Pokemon list/detail handlers to include nicknameSetAt in the response so frontend knows if nickname can be changed

tasks.title: Update TypeScript types for nicknameSetAt
tasks.description: Add nicknameSetAt field to Pokemon interfaces in the frontend

tasks.title: Show nickname prominently throughout UI
tasks.description: Ensure nickname (when set) is displayed instead of species name in: Collection grid, Team display, Trade modals, Evolution page. Currently partially done in some places.
